youtube.baslik: How do sounds seem when a cochlear implant is first switched on? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: On switch-on day, people often describe sounds as strange, mechanical or like beeps; this is expected. Because the person is not used to electrical stimulation, upper levels are set cautiously on the first day, that is, lower than needed, and raised step by step at later visits; the brain adapts to this new code over weeks and months.

cumleler: How do sounds seem when a cochlear implant is first switched on?
Switch-on usually comes a few weeks after surgery.
First sounds often seem strange, mechanical or like beeps.
On day one, upper levels are set cautiously, lower than needed.
As the person adapts, these levels are raised step by step.
The brain adapts to this new code over weeks and months.
